_about: Calibration of the simulator's sensor and base models from real data (2026-10-30). Sources: nav bags 2026-10-29 (120453, 131206) and 2026-10-30 (lab), 12 h static IMU log of the NX (2026-10-02). Scripts in notes/sim_realism/.

lidar_scan._about: REAL /scan (pointcloud_to_laserscan on FAST-LIO's cloud, closest point per 0.5 deg bin) in 38 stationary stretches (>=4 s, robot still). Per beam: core = frames within 10 cm of the beam's median; outliers = the rest (surface jumps of the 3D band collapsed to 2D, people).
lidar_scan.legacy_sim_sigma_m: 1 % of r up to 3 m, 2 % up to 5 m, 2.5 % beyond (RPLiDAR A2M12): 0.03 m at 3 m, 0.10 at 5 m, 0.25 at 10 m

imu._about: Allan variance of 11.97 h static /livox/imu (ICM-40609-D, 200 Hz). Static, motors off = LOWER BOUND. Accelerometer noise is not white (slope -0.6..-0.77): give the fitted range. Random walk K not determinable.
imu.legacy_sim: WT901C hard-coded: gyro white 1.75e-3 rad/s, acc white 0.02 m/s2, bias 3e-4 / 1e-2

base_response._about: actual motion (FAST-LIO derivative for v, gyro z for w) against the final /cmd_vel, motion only. Legacy sim: ideal DiffDrive (accel limits only).

angular_moving.note: gain 0.93-1.02 for |v cmd| > 0.03 m/s in all three bags

angular_in_place.note: w_actual = sign(u) * max(0, |u| - d) for |v cmd| < 0.03 m/s; 75-92 % of the samples with |u| < 0.15 move less than 0.02 rad/s in the worst session

caster_kick.direction: opposite to the previous turn, 0.5-2.5 s after the start of the forward motion; the first 0.25 s keep turning (+0.24)

wheel_odometry._about: reported /odom twist against the actual motion (same references).
